notice: Python and libraries on this page: 45 of the 79 worked examples run in your browser (Pyodide, Python 3.13.2) on the chapter's own library, loaded from a wheel embedded in this page (the names K, L and C are ready in every program, as in the deck's consoles), and equal what the research recorded under Python 3.14.6. The other 34 read a file saved with the chapter's evidence (a fetched source, a test-vector file or the record of Bitcoin Core 31.1.0's run on a test network), which a browser does not have: each is shown with its recorded output and the file it needs, under 'Recorded, not run on this page'. The sandbox check that sorted them ran each example under Python 3.13.14 with only the three library modules present.
